combatants._comment: Content Wave C1: canon Liscor-area ambush predator (wiki.wanderinginn.com/Shield_Spiders -- black-and-silver armored carapace, Silver-rank individually, nest under Liscor's Dungeon). A goblin_raider-class melee reskin nudged toward the carapace fantasy: +con (armored back), +dex (ambusher), lower int/cha. SPRITE STAND-IN: uses `bat` (the only dark cave-creature sheet in-tree) -- flagged in docs/VISUAL-LOG.md for a real arachnid sprite (Track B / PixelLab). Balance is MEASURED-only in sim_combat_batch.gd's ENCOUNTER_CELLS (see report).

Content Wave C1: the sewers' weak trash pack. Wiki lacks a named sewer-rat monster, so realized SPRITE-HONESTLY as cave bats (`bat` sheet, same as cave_spider's 'Cave Bat') -- canon-plausible tunnel vermin, flagged generic-diegetic per the spec. Deliberately fragile (low con/weapon_die) so the sewers_walkthrough autoplay clears it fast.

M-ARC A2: Raskghar scout -- canon nocturnal cave predator (wiki.wanderinginn.com/Raskghar): a cross between an upright bear and a lion, towers over Gnolls, ~Level-15-warrior strength, tracks and ambushes prey. A bruiser-class melee pair: high con/str, low int/cha. Serves DOUBLE duty -- the deep_tunnels route-fight pair AND the 2 scout adds in the Awakened's boss roster. combat_scale 0.4492 contains the hulking 124px frame at the feet (the Relc containment lesson); sprite is a real directional PixelLab v2 idle/walk/slice set. Balance MEASURED-only in sim_combat_batch.gd SCOUT_CELLS/BOSS_CELLS.

M-ARC A2: the Awakened Raskghar BOSS -- canon (a Raskghar that ate a Gnoll's heart, permanently smarter, matches a Level-20 warrior). High-HP bruiser (con 30 -> 50 max_hp). Its signature [Raskghar Maul] is a reaching slowed-rider swing on the EXISTING spell_damage+applies machinery (NO new effect type). `ai: caster` is REQUIRED, not decorative: the melee AI only fires attack/power_strike by name, so a `caster` boss (leads with the range-2 maul, falls through to claws) is the only shipped profile that actually LANDS the slow without a combat_ai.gd change (report AI-fit analysis). combat_scale 0.4839 lets it loom ~2 cells while HP bars stay readable. Balance: sim_combat_batch.gd BOSS_CELLS -- GATED 0.6-0.75 vs warrior2+Relc, measured solo. The boss ENCOUNTER entity + party/veto is A3; A2 ships the combatant + arena + harness band.
